$comment: Failing harness checks that are accepted for a limited time. Every entry needs an owner, an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD) and a rationale; an expired entry makes the check blocking again. See docs/security/RESIDUAL_RISKS.md.

risks.rationale: PV-SEC-004: clients cannot detect a server replaying an older revision of a record. Fixing it needs a protocol change (authenticated revision numbers bound into the payload AAD plus per-device high-water marks, or a signed per-vault change log) that requires specialist cryptographic review. Impact limited to a malicious/compromised server; data stays confidential.
